page.notes: Printed flourishes after "Quinta Regula" and "Titulus" are read as "?" but may be ornaments; the "?" marks are uncertain. The German title is in black letter and is marked with bl. The heading "QUIS EST SEPTIMUS" is set in italic capitals. A decorative rule divides the Quinta Regula paragraph from the title; it is not text. Initial "C" of the paragraph beginning "Concessimus" is a large letter joined to the word.
